verses.text: <pb/><t>Na yi murna sa'ad da suka ce mini,</t> <t>“Tashi mu tafi Haikalin Ubangiji!”</t>
<t>Ga shi kuwa, mun iso,</t> <t>Muna tsaye a ƙofofin Urushalima! <pb/></t>
<t>Urushalima birni ce wadda aka maido ta yadda take dā,</t> <t>Da kyakkyawan tsari, a shirye!</t>
<t>A nan kabilai sukan zo,</t> <t>Kabilan Isra'ila,</t> <t>Domin su yi godiya ga Ubangiji,</t> <t>Kamar yadda ya umarce su.</t>
<t>A nan majalisu suke,</t> <t>Wurin da sarki yake yi wa jama'arsa shari'a. <pb/></t>
<t>Ku yi wa Urushalima addu'ar salama!</t> <t>“Allah ya sa masu ƙaunarki su arzuta!</t>
<t>Salama ta samu a garukanki,</t> <t>Da zaman lafiya kuma a fādodinki.”</t>
<t>Saboda abokaina da aminaina,</t> <t>Na ce wa Urushalima, “Salama a gare ki!”</t>
<t>Saboda Haikalin Ubangiji, Allahnmu,</t> <t>Ina addu'a domin ki arzuta.</t>
